name: Bluetooth Headphones X — recurring charging issue
description: Contrast example: repeated charging and battery complaints in the synthetic sample.

reviews.text: The headphones stopped charging after three days of use.
After a few days, the device would not charge even with the original cable.
Charging stopped working on day four, so I could not recharge the headphones.
The headphones failed to charge after several days, despite trying another outlet.
It charged at first, then stopped charging after a few days.
After three days the charging indicator no longer came on.
The device would not take a charge after using it for a few days.
A few days after delivery, the headphones stopped charging.
Charging failed after a short period of use—around four days.
It worked for a few days, then would not charge anymore.
The battery drains very quickly, even after a full charge.
Battery life drops fast; I need to recharge much sooner than expected.
The battery drains rapidly during ordinary listening.
Charging works only sometimes; I have to reconnect the cable to get it started.
The charging connection is intermittent and does not work every time.
